Name: Non-AI Assets for Farmer's Notebook
Author: louisoftheforest
Description:
[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]Assets[/b][/size][/color]
This is the first version of this, with assets I've thrown together in an afternoon, but I do plan on reworking them and making them cleaner and prettier eventually.

[b]All Assets[/b] in this are either:
[list]
[*]Assets from the Game[/*]
[*]Completely drawn by me[/*]
[*]A mixture of In-Game Assets and my own drawing[/*]
[/list]There was[b] no AI involved[/b] in making these, since literally the whole point of this is to get rid of the slop. If you do find something that looks AI despite of this, don't hesitate to tell me so I can replace anything I've missed!

[b][color=#ffffff][size=5]Installation[/size][/color][/b]
These are [b]Assets only[/b], so in order for it to work you'll have to:
[list=1]
[*]Download the Original Mod [i](Linked in Requirements)[/i][/*]
[*]Download these Assets and exract them[/*]
[*]Find the Farmer's Notebook mod in your mod folder
[i](usually D:\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods)[/i][/*]
[*]Replace the Assets folder in it with the one you just downloaded[/*]
[/list][b]And you're done![/b]

Thank you for choosing the path of the Human, have fun playing💖
